meta_title: P W Steans & Sons | Painter & Decorator Leicester
meta_description: P W Steans & Sons Ltd is a trusted painter and decorator in Leicester. Expert interior and exterior work. Free quotes. Call 07711 990732 today.
hero_subhead: Whether it's a single room refresh or a full house transformation, we deliver flawless finishes on time and within budget.
services_heading: Complete Painting and Decorating Services in Leicester
services_subhead: From interior redecorating to exterior masonry work, we handle every job with meticulous attention to detail and professional standards.

services.title: Interior Decorating
services.desc: Full interior redecoration including wall preparation, emulsion and gloss finishing. We transform tired rooms into fresh, welcoming spaces with colour advice and quality finishes.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior work including fascia, soffit, and woodwork painting. We use premium products built to last and protect your home from the elements.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging
services.desc: Expert wallpaper selection and installation for any room. Our skilled paperhangers ensure seamless joins and a professional finish every time.

services.title: Masonry and Rendering
services.desc: Specialist external masonry finishing and render preparation. We create durable, attractive external finishes that enhance your property's curb appeal.

services.title: Woodwork and Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Careful preparation and finishing of doors, windows, skirting, and built-in joinery. We achieve smooth, durable gloss and satin finishes.

services.title: Colour Consultation
services.desc: Professional advice on colour schemes and finishes tailored to your home's style and natural light. We help you choose colours that work, not ones you'll regret.

about_pullquote: We treat every home like our own — honest work, no shortcuts, fair prices.
about_para_1: P W Steans & Sons was established 25 years ago and has built a reputation as one of Leicester's most reliable independent decorators. Started by Paul Steans, the business remains family-run and focused on delivering consistently high-quality work across Leicester Forest East and the wider area. Every job, from a single bedroom refresh to a complete house redecoration, receives the same meticulous attention.
about_para_2: Our repeat customer rate is exceptionally high because we listen to what homeowners actually want, turn up on time, and finish the work to a standard we'd be happy with in our own homes. We carry our own materials, work efficiently, and leave your home spotless. Word-of-mouth recommendations account for most of our new business — a testament to the trust our customers place in us.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About P W Steans & Sons

reviews.text: Paul came round and gave us a detailed free quote with honest advice on what needed doing. Work started on time and finished when he said it would. The whole house looks immaculate. Can't recommend highly enough.
reviews.author: David W.

reviews.text: Had Paul redecorate our sitting room and hallway. Brilliant attention to detail, prepared everything properly, and didn't leave a speck of paint anywhere. Very fair price too. Will definitely have him back.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant. Paul stripped and redecorated our bedroom and living room. Professional, tidy, and finished bang on schedule. Top bloke, very reasonable rates. Already recommending him to friends.
reviews.author: James M.
